part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the green panel and is now stopped in front of it. The sonar reads about 0.63 m to the panel. I called rest, so the robot is crouched with its motors off.

The corridor ran straight, then turned left twice before it reached the panel. The robot didn't fall and didn't bump into anything.
